name: turning-squares-disc
title: Turning Squares Disc
description: Inside a round window, a lattice of squares turns a quarter turn while two interleaved sets slide in opposite directions; then the colours swap, the dark squares become light on an accent field, and it turns again, looping seamlessly.
useWhen: A hypnotic geometric loop is needed as a background, a loader or a bumper.
A pattern should flip between two colour states without a cut.
avoidWhen: The motion competes with a lot of on-screen text.
A calm, still backdrop is needed.
author: chrisgannon
